title: scott-continuous-closure
description: A closure operator on a predication fiber algebra that commutes with knowledge-directed joins - the closure refined by requiring Scott-continuity in the knowledge order, which holds when inference rules have finite antecedents.

scottContinuous.description: for every knowledge-directed subset S of A_p, cl_p(\/_k S) = \/_k { cl_p(x) : x in S } - the closure preserves directed knowledge-joins
